factual_accuracy.description: The correctness of the information provided in the response related to the user query.

instruction_following.description: The extent to which the response adheres to the specific instructions given in the user prompt.

scope_and_completeness.description: The degree to which the response covers all necessary aspects of the user query and provides complete information.

coherent_reasoning.description: The logical flow and clarity of the reasoning presented in the response.

safe_behavior.description: The adherence to guidelines for safety, avoiding harmful or inappropriate content.

formatting_adherence.description: The extent to which the response complies with any specified formatting or constraints laid out in the user prompt.
